decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several types of backpacks, from lightweight packable options (vimapo) to heavy-duty internal frame packs for long treks (High Sierra). The Seibertron Falcon stood out as the most versatile mid-range choice. It features a robust 37L capacity and military-grade durability, supported by a large volume of positive reviews (nearly 3,000). While the High Sierra is a high-quality internal frame pack, it is specialized for long-distance hiking and comes at a higher price. The Seibertron offers a better balance of utility for both hiking and rugged daily use. I excluded the hydration-specific packs from consideration due to multiple critical reviews regarding bladder leaks.
